def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in comp); r1 = max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in comp); c1 = max(x for y,x in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = ({(r0,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r1,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)} |
                      {(y,c0) for y in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(y,c1) for y in range(r0,r1+1)})
            if set(comp) != border:
                continue
            # The enclosed rectangle alternates fill color by the parity of its cell count.
            fill = 7 if ((r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
